source.name: 4chan-vp-2015-threads
source.short-desc: Daily wget captures of /vp/ threads, June-October 2015, in 4chan's own markup
source.capture:
Four loose 7z volumes (vp_2015-06, -07, -08, -09+10), 124MB total, no images. There is NO single item zip — the previous prepare step expected source/4chan-vp-2015-threads.zip and would have failed outright.

Each volume holds daily wget captures laid out as <date>/vp/boards.4chan.org/vp/thread/<threadno>, e.g. 2015-06-01/vp/boards.4chan.org/vp/thread/23433058. vp_2015-06 alone is 8,027 files across 150 folders, 715MB uncompressed.

TWO THINGS PREPARE HAS TO NORMALISE, both of which would otherwise make the adapter silently find nothing:
  1. The pages have NO FILE EXTENSION. html-tree.ts only accepts names matching /\.html?$/, so an un-renamed tree yields zero pages.
  2. The layout is five levels deep and is neither of the two shapes html-tree recognises (flat <root>/<page>.html, or nested <root>/<board>/<page>.html).
So prepare flattens to out/vp/<date>_<threadno>.html.

THE DATE PREFIX IS DELIBERATE, NOT DECORATION. The same thread is captured on several consecutive days as it grows, and collapsing to <threadno>.html would keep only one of them. Since thread numbers and dates are read from the markup rather than the filename, the name is free — so every capture is kept and the UNIQUE (site, board, post_no) constraint unions their posts, giving the fullest version of each thread rather than whichever copy happened to win.

ADAPTER IS chan-html: verified on a sample page, which carries both `postContainer` and `data-utc` attributes, i.e. 4chan's own markup with true epoch timestamps and no timezone conversion needed. Not fybertech-html, which is for rendered third-party archives.
